criteria.text: R-8 comments preserve order and state, reject closed tickets, audit and enqueue distinct notifications. Confirm by: TC_Comments_Store and TC_Comments_Persist; pass when all assertions and restart/legacy checks succeed.
R-8 POST and GET expose comments and validate inputs. Confirm by: TC_Comments_API; pass when valid and invalid boundaries and status cases succeed.
R-8 notification delivers comment content. Confirm by: TC_Comments_Notify; pass when assigned recipient receives authored text and self/unassigned cases do not enqueue.
R-8 comment validator documents its input contract. Confirm by: search its docstring; pass when the public comment validator describes author and body.

expectations.statement: Store and persistence support durable comments and baseline tests pass after S1.
Existing HTTP routes and validation load
